ui.purpose: Identify initial activity preferences across broad RIASEC-inspired areas.
ui.prompt: Which of these activities sound appealing or interesting to you? (Select all that apply)

options.label: Building, fixing, or working outdoors/hands-on
options.detail: Working with tools, plants, animals, or physical materials (Realistic)

options.label: Analyzing data, solving puzzles, or researching ideas
options.detail: Understanding how things work, doing experiments, or deep-dive problem solving (Investigative)

options.label: Creating visual art, writing, music, or designing things
options.detail: Expressing ideas visually, verbally, or conceptually with open structure (Artistic)

options.label: Teaching, helping, advising, or supporting people
options.detail: Working closely with individuals or groups to assist, care, or guide (Social)

options.label: Leading projects, starting initiatives, or persuading others
options.detail: Organizing teams, selling ideas, managing ventures, or taking initiative (Enterprising)

options.label: Organizing information, managing details, or building orderly systems
options.detail: Working with clear routines, data records, schedules, or logistics (Conventional)
